test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - GK/CA (Held on: 20 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following measures is NOT related to the tax reform measures undertaken during the liberalisation phase?

options.text: Reduction in rates of income tax

solution:
The correct answer is __**Devaluation of Rupee**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Devaluation of the rupee is not related **to **tax reform measures undertaken during the liberalization phase. **
 
• Devaluation** is a monetary policy measure that involves lowering the value of a country's currency**.
 
• Tax reforms,** on the other hand, involve changing how taxes are collected or administered. **
 
• **Tax reforms**
 
• These **include lowering tax rates, simplifying the tax system, and broadening the tax base.**
 
• The goal of tax reforms is to improve tax administration and provide economic or social benefits​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Devaluation

 
 
• This is when a country's currency is officially lowered in value within a fixed exchange-rate system.
 
• Devaluation can be part of a trade policy reform package. 
 
 
 
• Liberalization
 
 
• This is the practice of removing or reducing restrictions on economic activity.
 
• The goal of liberalization is to end restrictions that hinder a nation's growth and development.
